create_LinearSpecification: create a linear specification module with coefficient matrix c and bias d for c^T * z_K + d <= 0 constraints
build_ClassificationSpecification: build a classification specification that verifies correct class logit exceeds all wrong class logits
test_TargetedClassificationSpecification: test a targeted classification specification comparing true class against a specified target class
create_RandomClassificationSpecification: create a random classification specification targeting a random class different from the true label
build_LeastLikelyClassificationSpecifica: build a least likely classification specification targeting the network's least confident class
